questions.q:
Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

(SSC MTS 2024 S.41_28-Oct_Shift-3)
o: It was a huge zoo with an elephant enclosure.
He was an honest engineer by profession.
Alka bought new pair of shoes for the party.
Suhas has a younger brother and an elder sister.
questions.s:
Answer:Alka bought new pair of shoes for the party.

Explanation:
The error is in the article usage before "pair". Since "pair" is a singular countable noun, it must be preceded by "a" or "a new", not just "new."

Incorrect: Alka bought new pair of shoes
Correct: Alka bought a new pair of shoes

Let’s check the other sentences:

  • It was a huge zoo with an elephant enclosure. → ✅ Correct

  • He was an honest engineer by profession. → ✅ "An" is correctly used before a vowel sound ("honest")

  • Suhas has a younger brother and an elder sister. → ✅ Correct

Corrected sentence:
Alka bought a new pair of shoes for the party.

questions.q: Select the option that converts the given sentence into the superlative degree.
o: The river Ganga has some of the most purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the very purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the more purest water on earth.
The river Ganga has some of the purest water on earth.
questions.s:
The correct option that converts the given sentence into the superlative degree is:

The river Ganga has some of the purest water on earth.

"Purest" is the superlative form of "pure," indicating the highest level of purity.

The use of "some of" implies that the Ganga has among the highest purity levels, and the superlative "purest" accurately conveys this meaning.

In summary, the sentence is correctly converted into the superlative degree by using "purest" to emphasize the exceptional purity of the water in the river Ganga.
